label: Every two-way giver at w with an invariant set-up HAS_WILL_1
paraphrase: For every being y: if y's set-up is invariant at w and y is a two-way giver at w (it gives some x being at w and does not give x being at an accessible world where it exists; TwoWayGiverAt), then y has will (HAS_WILL_1, the capacity). Nothing about the will's exercise or about God.
